title: Prophecy Against Gog of Magog

questions.question: Who is Ezekiel told to set his face against in the land of Magog?
options: Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal
Pharaoh, the king of Egypt
Balak, the king of Moab
Nimrod, the mighty hunter
questions.correctAnswer: Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:2 (ESV): "Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him"

questions.question: God says to Gog, "I will turn you about and put... in your jaws, and I will bring you out"
options: Hooks
A bit
A chain of iron
A flaming sword
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:4 (ESV): "And I will turn you about and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, and all your army, horses and horsemen..."

questions.question: Which nations does God list as being with Gog in his great army?
options: Persia, Cush, Put, Gomer, and Beth-togarmah
Egypt, Assyria, Babylon, and Edom
Tyre, Sidon, Philistia, and Ammon
Rome, Greece, Spain, and Tarshish
questions.correctAnswer: Persia, Cush, Put, Gomer, and Beth-togarmah
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:5-6 (ESV): "Persia, Cush, and Put are with them... Gomer and all his hordes; Beth-togarmah from the uttermost parts of the north..."

questions.question: In the latter years, where will Gog come against?
options: The land that is restored from war, the land whose people were gathered from many peoples upon the mountains of Israel
The great city of Babylon
The island of Patmos
The spiritual kingdom of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: The land that is restored from war, the land whose people were gathered from many peoples upon the mountains of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:8 (ESV): "In the latter years you will go against the land that is restored from war, the land whose people were gathered from many peoples upon the mountains of Israel..."

questions.question: How are the people living in the land of Israel when Gog decides to attack?
options: They are living securely, all of them
They are trembling in fear in their strongholds
They are in the midst of a terrible civil war
They are starving from a seven-year famine
questions.correctAnswer: They are living securely, all of them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:8 (ESV): "...its people were brought out from the peoples and now dwell securely, all of them."

questions.question: How is Gog's invading force described regarding its coverage of the land?
options: "You will advance, coming on like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land"
"You will be like a swarm of locusts eating every green thing"
"You will flow like a river flooding its banks"
"You will march in silence like shadows in the night"
questions.correctAnswer: "You will advance, coming on like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:9 (ESV): "You will advance, coming on like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you."

questions.question: What evil device/thought will Gog devise in his mind on that day?
options: "I will go up against the land of unwalled villages. I will fall upon the quiet people who dwell securely..." to seize spoil and plunder
"I will burn the temple of their God to the ground."
"I will make them my slaves and build my pyramids."
"I will demand a ransom of ten thousand talents of gold."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will go up against the land of unwalled villages. I will fall upon the quiet people who dwell securely..." to seize spoil and plunder
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:11-12 (ESV): "and say, 'I will go up against the land of unwalled villages. I will fall upon the quiet people who dwell securely... to seize spoil and carry off plunder...'"

questions.question: According to verse 12, who is Gog intending to seize spoil and carry off plunder from?
options: From the people who were gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and goods, who dwell at the center of the earth
From the kings of the south who fled to Israel
From the hidden vaults of Solomon
From the wealthy merchants of Tarshish passing through
questions.correctAnswer: From the people who were gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and goods, who dwell at the center of the earth
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:12 (ESV): "...to turn your hand against the waste places that are now inhabited, and the people who were gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and goods, who dwell at the center of the earth."

questions.question: Who will say to Gog, "Have you come to seize spoil? Have you assembled your hosts to carry off plunder?"
options: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all its leaders (or young lions)
The prophets of Israel
The angels of God
The king of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all its leaders (or young lions)
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:13 (ESV): "Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all its leaders will say to you, 'Have you come to seize spoil?...'"

questions.question: Why does God say He will bring Gog against His land?
options: That the nations may know Me, when through you, O Gog, I vindicate my holiness before their eyes
Because Israel must be punished again for new sins
Because God owes a debt to Gog
To test whether Israel will fight bravely
questions.correctAnswer: That the nations may know Me, when through you, O Gog, I vindicate my holiness before their eyes
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:16 (ESV): "You will come up against my people Israel... It will be in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me, when through you, O Gog, I vindicate my holiness before their eyes."

questions.question: Was Gog prophesied about by the prophets of Israel in former days?
options: Yes, God asks, "Are you he of whom I spoke in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel...?"
No, Gog is an entirely new enemy never before seen in visions
Yes, only by Isaiah
Yes, only by Daniel
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, God asks, "Are you he of whom I spoke in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel...?"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:17 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: Are you he of whom I spoke in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel, who in those days prophesied for years that I would bring you against them?"

questions.question: But on that day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, what will be roused?
options: God's wrath
The spirit of David
The giant Leviathan
The army of Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:18 (ESV): "But on that day, the day that Gog shall come against the land of Israel, declares the Lord God, my wrath will be roused in my anger."

questions.question: What physical event on the earth does God cause in His jealousy and blazing wrath?
options: A great earthquake in the land of Israel
A flood that covers the mountains
A three-day darkness
A raining of frogs and hail
questions.correctAnswer: A great earthquake in the land of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:19 (ESV): "For in my jealousy and in my blazing wrath I declare, On that day there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel."

questions.question: Besides the earthquake, what else will God summon against Gog on all His mountains?
options: The sword; every man's sword will be against his brother
An army of angels with flaming swords
A great plague of locusts
Lions and bears to devour them
questions.correctAnswer: The sword; every man's sword will be against his brother
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:21 (ESV): "I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains... Every man's sword will be against his brother."

questions.question: What elements will God rain upon Gog and his hordes?
options: Torrential rains and hailstones, fire and sulfur
Only brimstone from heaven
Sandstorms and hot winds
Poisonous arrows falling from the clouds
questions.correctAnswer: Torrential rains and hailstones, fire and sulfur
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:22 (ESV): "With pestilence and bloodshed I will enter into judgment with him, and I will rain upon him and his hordes and the many peoples who are with him torrential rains and hailstones, fire and sulfur."

key_verse_text: "So I will show my greatness and my holiness and make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am the Lord."
